sentences.text:
======================================================
 Rambabu Paswan S/o Musafir Paswan R/o Village and P.O.- Chakbigahia,
 Kalapahar, P.S.- Jandaha, District- Vaishali  ... .
 Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Chandani Devi W/o Mohan Pandit R/o Village- Kalapahar, P.S.- Jandaha,
 District- Vaishali
For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Vasant Vikas, Advocate  For the State : Mr.Raj Ballabh Singh, APP

======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 4 19-12-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2.
The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Jandaha P.S. Case No. 88 of 2022 registered for the offence punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 and 6 of the POCSO Act.
3. The petitioner is accused of committing rape with a six year old child.
5. Learned APP for the State has opposed the present bail application and has submitted that the trial has already commenced and therefore, this Court may not grant bail to the Patna High Court CR.

. 
6. Considering the gravity of offence and also the fact that the trial has already commenced, I am not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
